remarks: Welcome to Derbyshire Estate, a remarkable property where history, character, privacy & luxury come together. Built by Spencer Kellogg in 1876, this extraordinary 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath estate spans nearly 4,000 sq. ft. on 18.62 acres, tucked well back from the road for exceptional privacy. Step inside through the striking foyer & discover original craftsmanship, wide white-oak plank floors, soaring windows, elegant millwork & generous room sizes throughout. The sprawling first floor features a magnificent living room with gas fireplace, enormous formal dining room with second fireplace & access to one of three covered porches, plus a spectacular eat-in kitchen with granite counters, glass-pane cabinetry, Italian pietra flooring, copper sink, walk-in pantry, 6-burner Viking cooktop framed by original brick, double ovens & a restored 1800s icebox serving as the refrigerator. A second family/game room with wood-burning fireplace opens to a new hot tub & pergola, with adjoining office. A private guest suite offers a full bath, private entrance & covered porch. First-floor laundry & half bath add convenience. Upstairs, dual staircases lead to a spacious bedroom with full bath, an expansive primary suite with walk-in closet & updated bath featuring heated rain shower, plus versatile sitting/game space. A separate wing, once used as maids’ quarters, offers two bedrooms & full bath. Hidden beneath the home is a finished Prohibition-era speakeasy with copper bar, stone floors & wood-burning fireplace. Outside, manicured grounds feature apple, pear & peach trees, gunite pool, firepit, outdoor movie screen, multiple porches & panoramic views. Equestrian amenities include a brand-new Morton barn with six 12’x12’ stalls, wash stall, heated grain stall, 160’x80’ indoor arena & 160’x90’ outdoor arena, plus 3-bay garage. Located in an agricultural district where horses are permitted. Minutes from Sturgeon Point Marina, Lake Erie, bike trails & beach destinations, with easy access to downtown Buffalo. A rare opportunity to own WNY history, create your own legacy & experience the exceptional lifestyle that comes with Derbyshire Estate. View today! Offers reviewed as received.
